sampling.order: SHA256(registered_episode_id) among causal events with executable nonbaseline candidates

numeric_N.distance: D=depth residual/(15+1.4826*(two MAD)); A=48-bin RGB histogram L1/2; M=extrapolated centroid residual/history box diagonal
numeric_N.fusion: equal-weight within-packet candidate ranks for modalities available for every candidate
numeric_N.missing: exclude modality; all missing returns B0
numeric_N.unmatched: not allowed: each complete candidate assigns both historical identities exactly once

E1_decoding: one candidate strictly beats every other complete candidate; otherwise B0
